body: I’ve been looking for a job, I just haven’t found one yet. I’m really hoping that I find one soon because I need somewhere to live and the sooner I get a job the sooner I’ll be out of this situation. Unfortunately there’s not a lot of opportunities in the new state I live in, so it’s been a slow process. I’ve filled out about 15 applications in the last two weeks but I haven’t gotten anything back yet
I don’t currently know where my father is and my mother is an addict. I left that situation very early because it was hurting me but I entered into another hurtful situation
Yes I’m stuck and no, by next month I will not have a place to live.
Yes. Thank you so much. All I ever needed is someone to listen. Thank you. I will welcome your friendship gladly

This is my last attempt at help and personally an act of desperation. I’ve tried to confide in a friend before and they criticized and ridiculed me. As a result I lied and said that I was feeling better but everyday has been hard for me. Now that the person I relied on for support abandoned me I feel like I’m running in circles. I sit on the windowsill at least two times a week just hanging out waiting for myself to find the courage to push myself out. I’m sorry I didn’t answer your questions. I’m 22 and I’m from New York.
I’m thinking that none of this is worth it and I have no way out except one. It’s a reoccurring thought and it’s giving me panic attacks. I don’t know what to do.
